title: PORT-BRANCH-feat-account-split-provider-arch: carry feat/account-split-provider-arch onto main
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** branch `feat/account-split-provider-arch` at fafdb9db35 holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: deploy/cloudflare-accounts.json)
**Done check:** probe:git rev-list --count origin/main..origin/feat/account-split-provider-arch is 0, or the branch's content is carried by a merged change
**Status:** open

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 2 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch.

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation branchsweep --scan --json shows no `port` for feat/account-split-provider-arch
